Source: step 1 of the selected proof (test functions as top forms), with the determinant covector supplied by the sibling det_covector.
Notation: ℝⁿ = Euclid n = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) with Lebesgue measure; e := (e_0, …, e_{n−1}) with e_i := EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ), written in Lean as (fun i => EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)); for ω ∈ TestFormOn U n, ω(y) means (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid n) n) y.
1. (Determinant covector.) By the sibling det_covector (Submission.dgoj_exists_det_covector applied to n) there is δ ∈ Covector (Euclid n) n with δ(e) = 1.
2. (The test form ω_b.) Fix b : ℝⁿ → ℝ with ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) b, HasCompactSupport b and tsupport b ⊆ U, and put ω_b(y) := b(y)•δ. (a) ω_b is C^∞: it is the pointwise scalar multiple of the constant map y ↦ δ by the C^∞ function b (ContDiff.smul hb contDiff_const); the order (⊤ : ℕ∞), coerced to WithTop ℕ∞, is exactly the order ∞ of IsSmoothForm. (b) ω_b has compact support (HasCompactSupport.smul_right applied to the compact support of b). (c) tsupport ω_b ⊆ tsupport b ⊆ U (tsupport_smul_subset_left). By (a)–(c), IsTestForm ω_b ∧ tsupport ω_b ⊆ U, i.e. ω_b belongs to testFormOnSubmodule U n and defines an element ω_b ∈ TestFormOn U n.
3. (Evaluation on e.) For every y ∈ ℝⁿ, ω_b(y)(e) = (b(y)•δ)(e) = b(y)·δ(e) = b(y)·1 = b(y) (ContinuousAlternatingMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, step 1).
4. (Value of Y_k on ω_b.) By the representation hypothesis applied to ω_b and by step 3, for every k: Y_k(ω_b) = ∫_U u_k(y)·ω_b(y)(e) dy = ∫_U u_k(y)·b(y) dy; the two integrands coincide at every point y, so the two set integrals are equal (no measurability of U is used).
5. (Limit.) By the weak-convergence hypothesis applied to ω_b and by step 3, Y_k(ω_b) → c·∫_{ℝⁿ} ω_b(y)(e) dy = c·∫_{ℝⁿ} b(y) dy.
6. (Conclusion.) By step 4 the sequences k ↦ Y_k(ω_b) and k ↦ ∫_U u_k(y)b(y) dy agree termwise, so by step 5 (Tendsto.congr) ∫_U u_k(y)b(y) dy → c·∫_{ℝⁿ} b(y) dy. Since b was arbitrary, the claim holds. ∎

theorem Submission.cbr_ci_pw_l1_scalar_test_tendsto : ∀ (n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid n)) (c : ℝ) (Y : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U n) (u : ℕ → Euclid n → ℝ), (∀ (k : ℕ) (ω : TestFormOn U n), Y k ω = ∫ y in U, u k y * (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid n) n) y (fun i => EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, Tendsto (fun k => Y k ω) atTop (𝓝 (c * ∫ y, (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid n) n) y (fun i => EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))))) → ∀ b : Euclid n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) b → HasCompactSupport b → tsupport b ⊆ U → Tendsto (fun k => ∫ y in U, u k y * b y) atTop (𝓝 (c * ∫ y, b y)) := by
  intro n U c Y u hrep hweak b hb hbc hbU
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ⟩ := Submission.dgoj_exists_det_covector n
  have hmem : (fun y => b y • δ : DifferentialForm (Euclid n) n) ∈ testFormOnSubmodule (E := Euclid n) U n :=
    ⟨⟨hb.smul contDiff_const, hbc.smul_right⟩, (tsupport_smul_subset_left b (fun _ => δ)).trans hbU⟩
  let ω : TestFormOn U n := ⟨fun y => b y • δ, hmem⟩
  have hωe : ∀ y, (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid n) n) y (fun i => EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) = b y := by
    intro y
    simp [ω, hδ]
  have h1 := hweak ω
  simp only [hωe] at h1
  refine h1.congr (fun k => ?_)
  rw [hrep k ω]
  simp only [hωe]

ω_b := b·δ is a test n-form on U (C^∞, compact support, tsupport ω_b ⊆ tsupport b ⊆ U) with ω_b(y)(e) = b(y).
The representation gives Y_k(ω_b) = ∫_U u_k b for every k; weak convergence gives Y_k(ω_b) → c∫ω_b(·)(e) = c∫b; conclude by Tendsto.congr.
